key.name: toggle-spotlite
key.summary: Shortcut that opens and closes Spotlite

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Where the search bar was dragged to: [centre x, top y] as fractions of the screen; empty is the default spot

key.name: search-wikipedia
key.summary: Show Wikipedia articles (sends the query to wikipedia.org)

key.name: wikipedia-language
key.summary: Wikipedia language code, e.g. en, de, hi

key.name: search-dictionary
key.summary: Show English definitions (sends single words to dictionaryapi.dev and wiktionary.org)

key.name: search-files
key.summary: Show files from GNOME's search index (localsearch); stays on this computer

key.name: search-calculator
key.summary: Show the result of sums like 12*(3+4)

key.name: search-weather
key.summary: Answer weather questions (sends the city to open-meteo.com)

key.name: weather-location
key.summary: Home city for "weather" without a place; empty uses the city of the system time zone

key.name: wolfram-appid
key.summary: Wolfram|Alpha AppID; empty turns Wolfram|Alpha answers off

key.name: web-engine
key.summary: Search engine for the "Search the web" row
